text:
elaine.peopleops: Hi - I just became temporary guardian of my niece (court order dated 2026-02-10). Can I add her to medical/dental now? What docs do you need and what's the effective date/payroll impact?

naomi.peopleops: Yes this counts as a QLE. You have 30 days from 2026-02-10 to submit. Upload a copy of the court order showing guardianship, proof of residency (utility bill or school record), and the child's birth certificate. If guardianship is temporary, include the specific order details. :white_check_mark:

elaine.peopleops: Thanks - can coverage be retroactive to 2/10/26? Also do payroll deductions get prorated or will I see a catch-up charge?

mike.payroll: We can make coverage effective 2/10 once HR approves the QLE and we receive docs. Deductions start the next payroll after the effective date, and any retroactive premium is reconciled on your next paycheck as a pro-rated adjustment. If you prefer to delay to avoid a catch-up, tell us the later effective date. (cc @naomi.peopleops)

sara.benefits: Steps on the portal: go to https://benefits.redwood.com > Manage dependents > Add dependent. Choose "Qualifying life event" and pick "guardianship". Upload docs there (PDF or JPG). If you hit a carrier-specific screen asking for SSN and you don't have it, note that some carriers require SSN for dependent ID; please add if available to speed enrollment.

jordan.eng: FWIW, once enrolled you'll be able to request a dependent ID card via the carrier portal. Also if you need help scanning the court docs I can take pics on my break. :camera_flash: 

hr-bot: Reminder - QLE deadline is 30 days from event date. Missing docs may delay coverage or cause denial. If you need more than 30 days, request an exception with People Ops explaining why.

naomi.peopleops: Next steps for us: elaine, upload the three docs to the portal and reply here when done. I'll review within 3 business days and confirm effective date. mike will handle payroll reconciliation. If anything looks missing I'll DM you. :thumbsup:

elaine.peopleops: Uploaded the court order + birth certificate just now. Let me know if you need anything else. Thanks all!

naomi.peopleops: Got them - starting review now. Expect confirmation by EOD tomorrow.
